entries: This bow has multiple strings and resembles a lyre or small harp. By strumming the strings while setting an arrow to the bow, you imbue the arrow with magic.
You can play one of the following melodies when you use the bow to make a ranged weapon attack. You must choose to do so before you make the attack roll, and you can play only one melody per attack.
If you're proficient in {@skill Performance}, you gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll. If you have expertise in {@skill Performance}, you gain a +2 bonus instead.
entries.name: Melody of Precision

entries: The melody you strum echoes loudly. On a hit, the target takes extra thunder damage equal to your Charisma modifier.
entries.name: Melody of Reverberation
